podcast.title: Patrick Carney's Indie Label
podcast.body: This indie label is owned by Patrick Carney, and it notably signed the band Drummer, whose members are all drummers from other bands. "Patrick Carney was watching an indie band called Drummer, who was signed to his audio-eagle records."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Catching Up With The Black Keys

podcast.title: Patrick Carney's Record Label
podcast.body: Audio Eagle Records is an independent record label owned by Patrick Carney, which notably signed the band Drummer, in which Carney also played bass. "Patrick Carney was watching an indie band called Drummer, who was signed to his audio-eagle records."
